> **Pipeline step 00-2 — data preparation (depth validation).**
>
> **Purpose.** Estimate, for every TPS station at its sample date-time, the water-surface
> elevation (NOAA CO-OPS gauges, NAVD88), the tidal stage, and a bathymetry-based water depth
> (WSE minus DEM bed elevation), and compare these with the field-recorded tide and start depth.
>
> **Web data.** This notebook calls the NOAA CO-OPS data and metadata APIs and the NOAA VDatum
> API directly (endpoints in the `setup` chunk, request helpers in `helpers`, the pull in
> `compute`). The DEM bed elevations are read from `data/tps_bed_navd88.csv`, produced by
> `download_dem_and_extract_beds()` in `00_data/00_download_web_data.R`.
>
> **Inputs.** `data/tps_forklength_data.csv`, `data/Tidal_Parr_Complete_tides.csv`,
> `data/station_code_timestamp.csv`, `data/Tide_Stations.csv`, `data/tps_bed_navd88.csv`.
>
> **Output.** `data/tps_station_depth_tide.csv` (one row per StationCode, metric).
>
> **Cost.** A few minutes (network-bound).

```{r project-root, include=FALSE}
# Every path in this notebook (data/, fits_*/, output_figs/, cache/) is relative to the
# REPOSITORY ROOT, not to this file's sub-folder. Walk up from the working directory to the
# folder holding the .Rproj file, and make knitr (and RStudio's chunk-by-chunk notebook
# mode) run every chunk from there. Base R only -- no extra package needed.
find_repo_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  p <- normalizePath(path)
  while (!length(list.files(p, pattern = "\\.Rproj$"))) {
    if (dirname(p) == p) stop("No .Rproj file found above ", path)
    p <- dirname(p)
  }
  p
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = find_repo_root())
```
For each trawl `StationCode` at its **sample date-time**, estimate a water-surface elevation
(WSE, NAVD88) and a **tidal stage** (flood/ebb/slack) from NOAA stage data, pull the bed
elevation from a NAVD88 bathymetric DEM, and assemble a **per-station comparative table**
(one row per `StationCode`, ~69 stations) against the field-recorded `Tide` and `Start_Depth`.
The table is keyed by `StationCode` so it can be joined back to the fork-length data.

**All elevations/depths are in metres (NAVD88 where vertical).** `Start_Depth` (field, feet)
is converted to metres.

Date-times are pooled from `data/Tidal_Parr_Complete_tides.csv` (2019) and
`data/station_code_timestamp.csv` (2018/2020/2021) — together covering all 134 fish rows,
which collapse to 69 stations.

WSE source routing: operational gauges Port Chicago (9415144) & Martinez-Amorco (9415102) →
observed NAVD88; all other (subordinate) stations → MLLW predictions + a **per-station
VDatum MLLW→NAVD88 offset** (NOAA VDatum REST API, evaluated at the NOAA gauge location;
falls back to a regional proxy if VDatum is unavailable). To keep it cheap, NOAA is queried
only in a short window around each sample (cached per station+source+date).

Bathymetry: `bed_navd88_m` is read from the 2016 USGS/DWR SF Bay-Delta 10-m DEM (NAVD88,
metres), cached to `data/tps_bed_navd88.csv` (so this notebook does not need the 1.28 GB DEM
on re-render). `bed_navd88_m` is the **exact DEM cell at the station coordinates** — the
coordinates are precise, so the cell at the GPS location is used as-is (no buffering), even
where it falls on a bank.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)

NOAA   <- "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter"
MDAPI  <- "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations"
VDATUM <- "https://vdatum.noaa.gov/vdatumweb/api/convert"
OPERATIONAL <- c("9415144", "9415102")   # verified: continuous obs water level + NAVD88
SLACK_MIN   <- 45                        # +/- minutes from an extreme counted as slack
FT2M        <- 0.3048
```

## NOAA / VDatum helpers (metric)

```{r helpers}
# Series (NAVD88, metres) for a short window: observed for operational, MLLW->NAVD88 predictions else.
fetch_series <- function(station, source, begin, end, offset){
  if(source == "observed_NAVD88"){
    u <- sprintf("%s?product=water_level&application=tps&begin_date=%s&end_date=%s&datum=NAVD&station=%s&time_zone=lst_ldt&units=metric&format=json",
                 NOAA, format(begin,"%Y%m%d"), format(end,"%Y%m%d"), station)
    j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(u), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(j$data)) return(tibble())
    return(transmute(j$data, dt = ymd_hm(t), val = as.numeric(v)))
  }
  # predictions: 6-min for harmonic stations, else densify high/low with half-cosine
  pred <- function(interval){
    iv <- if(is.null(interval)) "" else paste0("&interval=", interval)
    u <- sprintf("%s?product=predictions&application=tps&begin_date=%s&end_date=%s&datum=MLLW%s&station=%s&time_zone=lst_ldt&units=metric&format=json",
                 NOAA, format(begin,"%Y%m%d"), format(end,"%Y%m%d"), iv, station)
    tryCatch(fromJSON(u), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  j <- pred(NULL)
  if(!is.null(j$predictions) && is.null(j$predictions$type)){
    s <- transmute(j$predictions, dt = ymd_hm(t), val = as.numeric(v))
  } else {
    jh <- pred("hilo"); if(is.null(jh$predictions)) return(tibble())
    hl <- transmute(jh$predictions, dt = ymd_hm(t), val = as.numeric(v)) %>% arrange(dt)
    grid <- seq(min(hl$dt), max(hl$dt), by = "6 min")
    vals <- map_dbl(grid, function(tt){
      i <- max(which(hl$dt <= tt)); if(i >= nrow(hl)) return(hl$val[nrow(hl)])
      a <- hl[i,]; b <- hl[i+1,]
      f <- as.numeric(difftime(tt, a$dt, units="secs")) / as.numeric(difftime(b$dt, a$dt, units="secs"))
      a$val + (b$val - a$val) * (1 - cos(pi*f))/2
    })
    s <- tibble(dt = grid, val = vals)
  }
  mutate(s, val = val + offset)   # MLLW -> NAVD88 (metres)
}

# MLLW->NAVD88 and MSL->NAVD88 offsets (metres) from the datums product (NAVD only at operational stns).
station_datums <- function(station){
  d <- tryCatch(fromJSON(sprintf("%s/%s/datums.json?units=metric", MDAPI, station)),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(d$datums)) return(c(mllw_navd = NA, msl_navd = NA))
  v <- setNames(d$datums$value, d$datums$name)
  c(mllw_navd = if(all(c("MLLW","NAVD88") %in% names(v))) unname(v["MLLW"]-v["NAVD88"]) else NA,
    msl_navd  = if(all(c("MSL","NAVD88")  %in% names(v))) unname(v["MSL"] -v["NAVD88"]) else NA)
}

# Per-point VDatum MLLW(m)->NAVD88(m) offset; with s_z=0 the returned t_z IS the offset (metres).
vd_cache <- new.env()
vdatum_offset <- function(id, lon, lat){
  key <- as.character(id)
  if(!is.null(vd_cache[[key]])) return(vd_cache[[key]])
  u <- sprintf("%s?s_x=%f&s_y=%f&s_z=0&region=westcoast&s_coor=geo&s_h_frame=IGS14&t_h_frame=NAD83_2011&s_v_frame=MLLW&s_v_unit=m&t_v_frame=NAVD88&t_v_unit=m",
               VDATUM, lon, lat)
  j   <- tryCatch(fromJSON(u), error = function(e) NULL)
  off <- if(!is.null(j$t_z)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(j$t_z)) else NA_real_
  vd_cache[[key]] <- off
  off
}

# Tidal stage from a stage series at time t: Flood/Ebb (Early/Late) or High/Low Slack.
classify_stage <- function(s, t){
  if(nrow(s) < 5) return(NA_character_)
  s <- arrange(s, dt)
  sm <- stats::filter(s$val, rep(1/5, 5)); sm[is.na(sm)] <- s$val[is.na(sm)]  # ~30-min smooth
  dsign <- sign(diff(sm))
  ext_i <- which(dsign[-1] != dsign[-length(dsign)]) + 1                       # turning points
  ext <- tibble(dt = s$dt[ext_i], val = s$val[ext_i],
                type = if_else(diff(sm)[ext_i-1] > 0, "High", "Low"))
  if(nrow(ext) == 0) return(if(approx(as.numeric(s$dt), s$val, as.numeric(t+1800))$y >
                               approx(as.numeric(s$dt), s$val, as.numeric(t-1800))$y) "Flood" else "Ebb")
  near <- ext[which.min(abs(difftime(ext$dt, t, units="mins"))), ]
  if(abs(as.numeric(difftime(near$dt, t, units="mins"))) <= SLACK_MIN)
    return(paste(near$type, "Slack"))
  prev <- ext %>% filter(dt <= t) %>% slice_tail(n=1)
  nxt  <- ext %>% filter(dt >  t) %>% slice_head(n=1)
  if(nrow(prev)==0 || nrow(nxt)==0){
    rising <- approx(as.numeric(s$dt), s$val, as.numeric(t+1800))$y >
              approx(as.numeric(s$dt), s$val, as.numeric(t-1800))$y
    return(if(rising) "Flood" else "Ebb")
  }
  phase <- if(nxt$type == "High") "Flood" else "Ebb"
  frac  <- as.numeric(difftime(t, prev$dt, units="secs")) /
           as.numeric(difftime(nxt$dt, prev$dt, units="secs"))
  paste(if(frac < 0.5) "Early" else "Late", phase)
}
```

## Assemble per-station samples and offsets

```{r samples, message=FALSE}
fl <- read_csv("data/tps_forklength_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

ts <- bind_rows(
  read_csv("data/Tidal_Parr_Complete_tides.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(Site_Id, Date_Time),
  read_csv("data/station_code_timestamp.csv",   show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(Site_Id, Date_Time)
) %>%
  mutate(dt = parse_date_time(Date_Time, orders = "mdY HM")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dt)) %>% distinct(Site_Id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# NOAA tide-station locations (used both for nearest-station and for per-station VDatum offsets).
stn <- read_csv("data/Tide_Stations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(lat = Latitude, lon = Longitude) %>% filter(grepl("^94", stationID))
nearest_stn <- function(la, lo){
  d <- sqrt((stn$lat-la)^2 + ((stn$lon-lo)*cos(la*pi/180))^2); stn$stationID[which.min(d)]
}

# One row per StationCode (Start_Depth / Tide / coords are constant within a station; only
# fork length varies across the duplicate fish rows).
samples <- fl %>%
  distinct(StationCode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(select(ts, Site_Id, dt), by = c("StationCode" = "Site_Id")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dt)) %>%
  transmute(StationCode, dt, Year, Tide_field = Tide,
            start_depth_m = Start_Depth * FT2M,
            lat = Station_Latitude, lon = Station_Longitude) %>%
  mutate(near_id = map2_chr(lat, lon, nearest_stn),
         source  = if_else(near_id %in% OPERATIONAL, "observed_NAVD88", "pred_MLLW"))

cat("stations:", nrow(samples), "of", n_distinct(fl$StationCode), "unique StationCodes\n")

# Regional reference offsets from the operational gauges.
op <- map(OPERATIONAL, station_datums)
mllw_navd_proxy <- mean(map_dbl(op, "mllw_navd"))   # fallback for subordinate stations
msl_navd_ref    <- mean(map_dbl(op, "msl_navd"))    # MSL height in NAVD88 (mean-water reference, m)
cat(sprintf("regional MLLW->NAVD88 proxy = %.2f m | MSL(NAVD88) ref = %.2f m\n",
            mllw_navd_proxy, msl_navd_ref))

# Per-station VDatum MLLW->NAVD88 offsets at each used (subordinate) NOAA gauge; fall back to proxy.
used_sub <- samples %>% filter(source == "pred_MLLW") %>% distinct(near_id) %>%
  left_join(select(stn, stationID, lat, lon), by = c("near_id" = "stationID"))
used_sub <- used_sub %>%
  mutate(vdatum_offset_m = pmap_dbl(list(near_id, lon, lat), vdatum_offset))
n_vd <- sum(!is.na(used_sub$vdatum_offset_m))
cat(sprintf("VDatum offsets: %d of %d subordinate gauges resolved (rest use regional proxy)\n",
            n_vd, nrow(used_sub)))
offset_map <- used_sub %>%
  transmute(near_id, offset = coalesce(vdatum_offset_m, mllw_navd_proxy)) %>%
  deframe()
station_offset <- function(id, src) if(src == "observed_NAVD88") 0 else unname(offset_map[as.character(id)])
```

## Pull stage windows (cached) and compute WSE + tidal stage (metres)

```{r compute, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cache <- new.env()
get_window <- function(id, source, day){
  key <- paste(id, source, day)
  if(is.null(cache[[key]]))
    cache[[key]] <- fetch_series(id, source, as.Date(day) - 1, as.Date(day) + 1,
                                 offset = station_offset(id, source))
  cache[[key]]
}

res <- samples %>%
  mutate(
    vdatum_offset_m = map2_dbl(near_id, source, station_offset),
    wse_navd88_m    = pmap_dbl(list(near_id, source, dt), function(id, src, t){
      s <- get_window(id, src, as.Date(t)); if(nrow(s)==0) return(NA_real_)
      approx(as.numeric(s$dt), s$val, as.numeric(t))$y }),
    tidal_stage_est = pmap_chr(list(near_id, source, dt), function(id, src, t){
      classify_stage(get_window(id, src, as.Date(t)), t) }),
    tide_anom_m     = wse_navd88_m - msl_navd_ref,   # +above / -below mean water (m)
    depth_norm_m    = start_depth_m - tide_anom_m    # field depth referenced to mean water (m)
  )

cat("WSE computed:", sum(!is.na(res$wse_navd88_m)), "of", nrow(res),
    "| tidal stage computed:", sum(!is.na(res$tidal_stage_est)), "\n")
```

## Join cached bed elevations and build the comparison

```{r bed, message=FALSE}
bed <- read_csv("data/tps_bed_navd88.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)   # from the 2016 SF Bay-Delta 10-m DEM

comp <- res %>%
  left_join(bed, by = "StationCode") %>%
  mutate(
    est_depth_m   = wse_navd88_m - bed_navd88_m,        # bathymetry-based water depth (m)
    depth_resid_m = est_depth_m - start_depth_m         # estimate minus field depth (m)
  ) %>%
  transmute(StationCode, datetime = dt, Year,
            Tide_field, tidal_stage_est,
            near_id, source, vdatum_offset_m = round(vdatum_offset_m, 3),
            wse_navd88_m  = round(wse_navd88_m, 3),
            tide_anom_m   = round(tide_anom_m, 3),
            start_depth_m = round(start_depth_m, 2),
            depth_norm_m  = round(depth_norm_m, 2),
            bed_navd88_m,
            est_depth_m   = round(est_depth_m, 2),
            depth_resid_m = round(depth_resid_m, 2)) %>%
  arrange(datetime)

# Field vs estimated stage, where field tide was recorded.
simplify <- function(x) str_remove(x, "^(Early|Late)\\s+")
check <- comp %>% filter(!is.na(Tide_field)) %>%
  mutate(agree = simplify(Tide_field) == simplify(tidal_stage_est))
cat(sprintf("Field tide recorded for %d stations; phase agreement (Flood/Ebb/Slack): %d (%.0f%%)\n",
            nrow(check), sum(check$agree), 100*mean(check$agree)))

# Depth comparison summary.
dd <- comp %>% filter(!is.na(depth_resid_m))
cat(sprintf("Depth comparison (n=%d): median resid = %.2f m | MAE = %.2f m | corr(est, field) = %.2f\n",
            nrow(dd), median(dd$depth_resid_m), mean(abs(dd$depth_resid_m)),
            cor(dd$est_depth_m, dd$start_depth_m)))

write_csv(comp, "data/tps_station_depth_tide.csv")
cat("saved -> data/tps_station_depth_tide.csv (", nrow(comp), "stations )\n")
head(comp, 15)
```

`data/tps_station_depth_tide.csv` is the deliverable — **one row per `StationCode`** (join key
to the fork-length data). All metric. Columns:

- `Tide_field` / `tidal_stage_est` — recorded vs stage-derived tide phase.
- `near_id` / `source` — nearest NOAA gauge and whether WSE is observed NAVD88 or
  MLLW-prediction + offset; `vdatum_offset_m` — the per-station MLLW→NAVD88 offset applied
  (0 for observed gauges).
- `wse_navd88_m` — estimated water-surface elevation (NAVD88, m); `tide_anom_m` — WSE relative
  to mean water; `start_depth_m` — recorded depth (m); `depth_norm_m` — recorded depth corrected
  to mean water.
- `bed_navd88_m` — DEM bed elevation at the exact station cell (no buffering).
  `est_depth_m = wse_navd88_m - bed_navd88_m` is the bathymetry-based depth;
  `depth_resid_m = est_depth_m - start_depth_m` is the comparison.

**Caveats:** subordinate-station WSE uses the nearest NOAA gauge's tide curve as a spatial proxy
(tidal phase/amplitude shift across the estuary) and per-station VDatum offsets (±~0.08 m model
uncertainty); predictions, not observations, drive most rows. `bed_navd88_m` is the single 10-m
DEM cell at the station coordinates (some cells fall on banks, so `est_depth_m` can be small or
negative), and `Start_Depth` is a rough field reading, so `depth_resid_m` carries several-metre
scatter.
